test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 27 Jun, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the sentence that uses the given idiom correctly.

Skating on thin ice

options.text: They were on thin ice when they skated on the frozen lake.
She was on thin ice while trying to balance on a tightrope.
He was on thin ice after making a controversial statement.
They were on thin ice due to the icy conditions on the road.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"Skating on thin ice"** means to be in a risky or dangerous situation. (खतरे में होना)

 
 
• **Example: **After failing to meet the deadline, she knew she was skating on thin ice with her boss.
 
 
 
• **He was on thin ice after making a controversial statement** correctly uses the idiom to indicate that he **was in a risky situation **because of his statement. (वह एक विवादास्पद बयान देने के बाद खतरे में था)
 
 
• **Example: **After criticizing the management openly, he realized he was** on thin ice.**
 
 

Therefore, the correct meaning of the given statement is **'He was on thin ice after making a controversial statement.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1:** They were on thin ice when they skated on the frozen lake. (जब वे जमी हुई झील पर स्केटिंग कर रहे थे तो वे खतरे में थे)

 
 
• This sentence **uses **the** idiom literally rather than metaphorically.**
 
 
 
• **Option 2:** She was on thin ice while trying to balance on a tightrope. (तंग रस्सी पर संतुलन बनाते समय वह खतरे में थी)
 
 
• This sentence **confuses** two idioms: **"on thin ice" and "walking a tightrope".**
 
 
 
• **Option 4:** They were on thin ice due to the icy conditions on the road. (सड़क पर बर्फीली स्थिति के कारण वे खतरे में थे)
 
 
• This sentence also** uses t**he** idiom literally rather than metaphorically.**
 
 

3ac:Td98,

The correct answer is **Option 4)**
